tools.name: notice_deadlines
tools.description: Calculates when a tenant in Québec must receive the notice of rent increase or lease modification (art. 1942 C.C.Q.), whether that window is open today, and, if a receipt date is given, the date by which the tenant must reply (art. 1945 C.C.Q.). Works for fixed-term leases of 12 months or more, shor

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Searches ProprioSign’s guides for Québec landlords (deadlines, how to send the notice, proof of receipt, co-tenants, tenant refusal or no reply, tenant leaving, rooms, indeterminate leases, language of the notice, e-signature). Returns titles, links and summaries.

tools.name: read_guide
tools.description: Returns the full text of one ProprioSign guide in Markdown, with its official sources. Give the slug or URL returned by search_guides.

tools.name: about_propriosign
tools.description: What ProprioSign does, who it is for, prices, when it opens, frequently asked questions and the links to give to a landlord.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_guide · Public sink: search_guides.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_guide · Public sink: search_guides

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
